rationale: The assistant reached the correct cause (worn, charred carbon brushes) with the machine unplugged and gave a sensible instruction to inspect the motor housing for scorching before fitting. It lost a turn by inventing appliance features that do not exist on this model ('small square access panel on the bottom right of the front casing', then a 'small square metal plate' on the back) and never asked the simple drum-by-hand check. The repeated 'Stop using this appliance' banner saying 'don't run it again... until it has been checked by a qualified engineer' was then contradicted by 'plug the machine back in and try a spin programme', and there was no fallback escalation if new brushes do not restore drive. Stating 'IWC 71252' is enough to find the correct brushes is a mild over-claim since brush fit depends on the motor variant.
